equip_instructions: Fetch the reference file: GET https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/streetlight/streetlight.json — no login, no cookies, one fetch
Open https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/streetlight/ to render any streetlight.json: by URL (?url=...), by paste, or CWI's own

Publish your own at https://your-site/streetlight.json following https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/streetlight/streetlight-schema.json (cwi-streetlight/v1). Counts are publisher-attested; null with "attested": false until you attest. Aggregates only — zero PII.

item.description: The Data department's agent-analytics product, #11 of the Agent Deck gear line. A single machine-readable streetlight.json any site publishes at a standard path — its public traction vitals, readable by any agent with one fetch. No login, no JavaScript, no cookies, no sampling, zero PII (aggregates only). Beats Google Analytics 4 where agents read: the file IS the API, free forever. Equips as a utility-slot read/render layer for any agent that reads the web for a living.
item.name: THE STREETLIGHT
